# Continuity Vault

A Muse agent skill that keeps your work alive across sessions: craft handoffs that a new session can actually resume from, extract key information from a session's transcript, promote content between sessions, audit what a handoff claims against what happened, and build digests that compress a session into its essence. Works with any session transcript — Claude Code, Cursor, or others. No account, no API key, no network needed.
